# wow-forever-buff-reminder-addon - WoW Forever Buff Reminder Addon ByJTT

> Taint-safe, WoW-authentic missing-buff reminder for World of Warcraft: Forever. ByJTT foundation reference implementation. By ByJTT (solo studio).

- Repo: https://github.com/ByJTT/wow-forever-buff-reminder-addon
- Display name (TOC Title, "AddonName ByJTT" style): `WoW Forever Buff Reminder Addon ByJTT`
- In-game addon folder name (critical, must remain stable): `ForeverBuffReminder`
- Purpose: show missing buffs as secure click-to-cast icons (only when needed). Data-driven engine + curated catalog; scales to all classes/races/buffs (curated v1, extensible).
- Scope/target: World of Warcraft: Forever (Interface 16001, 30300). Feature-detected API fallbacks. No Ace/framework deps.
- Install path: `<WoW Forever>/Interface/AddOns/ForeverBuffReminder/ForeverBuffReminder.toc`
- Required in-game files: `ForeverBuffReminder.toc`, `ForeverBuffReminder.lua`.
- Commands: `/fbr help|config|lock|unlock|move|scale|grow|pulse|sound|form|reset|test|debug|onboarding|rl` (legacy: `motw|thorns`).
- Safety: SecureActionButtonTemplate attribute casting; **no** `OnClick`/`PreClick`/`PostClick` on secure buttons; protected changes deferred out of combat (`InCombatLockdown`/`PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED`).
- Branding/support (public): by ByJTT - https://byjtt.com - https://github.com/ByJTT - Support placeholder: https://buymeacoffee.com/ByJTT (replace with real URL when ready).
- Issues: include WoW Forever build/interface, addon version (`/fbr debug`), steps, expected/actual, Lua errors (`/console scriptErrors 1`). No account data/local personal paths.
- License: MIT.
